The review section above was written at ~15:2x while the detached child was still drawing sub-floor (35 draws, all STAND-DOWN:mem<floor) and read the likely outcome as a draws-exhausted STAND-DOWN. That reading is SUPERSEDED. Headroom recovered: DRAW 70 (15:30:02Z) read mem_mib=2296 >= 2200 -> FIRE.
